Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all distinct molecules mentioned in document CHEMBL1123860. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to enforce availability of canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL1123860. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
